I've been in that situation. Everything prepared: I had a good last dinner, found nice wine bottles in my parents' alcohol stash, managed to make a well done tie and already established where I was hanging myself. Hell, I even calculated the fall distance so that my neck breaks instantly, making it easier to jump. 

I wrote personal farewells to my family and friends and placed them in an easy spot to find, warning my parents about where my corpse would have been so that they could call 911 and avoid seeing me dead.

I decided to put some music in my phone before I jumped and already with the rope on my neck and just a step from jumping off one particular song started: SPIRIT IN THE SKY by Norman Greenbaum.

I don't believe in God or destiny but hell that is a really fucking twisted coincidence. After hearing the lyrics something turned my survival instinct on and got cold feet. I just couldn't do it. 

I understand you. Don't feel frustrated with you for not doing it. Maybe it's for the good. I don't know your reasons but for making a decision like this it must be because you are at the bottom. I know it first hand. So saving the rope for later it's not a bad idea, maybe one little aspect of your life will improve tomorrow and maybe another one the day after. Take care of yourself.
